description:
Situated on the upper Seymour River, this is part of the legendary road to the Columbia Gold Fields and the site of the old Cotton Belt Mine on Mt. Grace.

Trail length is 6.4 km of moderate but steady climb between river level and alpine meadow. This will take a full day. In order to hike this trail, you must be an expert at finding and following old trails, otherwise you will be lost quite often.

Caution - active logging road and grizzly bear habitat.
directions: It's about 29km NE of Seymour Arm.
title: Cottonbelt Trail
